title: Grade 5 Science — How Air, Water, Land, and Life Interact
subject: Science
description: Practice with questions on atmosphere, hydrosphere, geosphere, biosphere.
creator: Teach Arcade

questions.question: Which system includes the air around Earth?
Which system includes living organisms?
Which system includes most of Earth's rocks and soil minerals?
Which system includes water in rivers and lakes?
A tree uses water from the ground. Which systems interact most directly in that uptake?
Waves wear away a rocky shore. Which two systems interact?
How does a volcano directly affect the atmosphere during an eruption?
choices: It turns air to solid rock everywhere.
It releases ash and gases into air.

questions.question: Which describes wind directly affecting the geosphere?
choices: Wind pushes clouds across the sky.
Wind moves sand to build a dune.
Wind carries a hawk through the air.

questions.question: Rain runs across a farm field into a stream. Which system includes this moving water?
What is one way forest plants affect air next to them?
choices: They turn all nitrogen into solid soil.

questions.question: Which example directly links the biosphere with the geosphere?
choices: Roots grow into cracks in rock.
A storm blows leaves through the air.
A river drops sand at its mouth.

questions.question: Clouds form as water vapor cools and makes droplets. Which systems meet in the cloud?
Which process moves water from a lake to the air as vapor?
How can beavers affect the water in their habitat?
choices: Their dams can slow streams and form ponds.
They turn fresh water salty in every stream.
They create new water inside rocks.

questions.question: How could sandy soil affect stormwater at the surface?
choices: It can let water soak in through gaps.
It makes clouds form below ground.
It changes water to air on contact.

questions.question: How can removing trees from a steep slope change interactions among Earth systems?
choices: The slope will never get rain again.
Less cover can let runoff remove more soil.
Water can no longer flow downhill.

questions.question: Which chain shows water moving through different parts of Earth?
choices: dry rock → leaf color → sunlight → air pressure

questions.question: What can happen if river water floods a field?
choices: Water can leave sediment on the ground.

questions.question: Which system includes water stored as glacier ice?
Which observation would best help compare a planted slope with a bare slope after a storm?
choices: the amount of sediment washed off each
the color of the nearest building
